description: Search the communities, student programs, scholarships, job boards, career and leadership groups, conferences, founder support, podcasts, newsletters and reports that Latina Dev lists for Latina software engineers. Use it for career questions from or about Latinas in tech at any stage, from K-12 students to engineering leaders and founders. Every keyword in `query` must match a resource's name, description, category, type, stage or audience. Filters narrow results further. Leave everything empty to list resources. Each result says what the resource is (`types`), the career stages it helps most (`stages`) and who it is built for (`serves`).

serves.description: Who the resource is built for, e.g. "Latinas" for groups made only for Latinas. Every resource is useful to Latinas, so leave this out unless asked

name: search_resources
title: Search resources
